name: @pipeworx/mcp-ai-incident-db

tools.name: search_incidents
tools.description: Search the AI Incident Database. Combines free-text with date range filters. Returns incident IDs, titles, dates, and a short blurb.

query.description: Free-text. Every word must appear somewhere in the incident title or description, in any order — "facial recognition bias" finds records mentioning all three, not that exact phrase. Fewer words match more.

start_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD lower bound on incident date

tools.name: get_incident
tools.description: Fetch a full AI Incident Database record by numeric incident_id; returns title, date, description, alleged deployer/developer/harmed parties, and all linked news report URLs.

tools.name: list_taxonomies
tools.description: Taxonomies used to classify incidents (CSET-AIID, GMF, RAIC).

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-ai-incident-db forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the ai-incident-db pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
